findings.message: Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like func_get_args(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$message" was used, and possibly changed (by reference), on line 416. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this behaviour, so the upgrade changes nothing)

Declaring an optional parameter before a required parameter is deprecated since PHP 8.0. Parameter $args is optional, while parameter $i is required. The $args parameter is implicitly treated as a required parameter.
Function strptime() is deprecated since PHP 8.1; Use date_parse_from_format() or IntlDateFormatter::parse() instead
